scope_precondition.statement: The ordering experiments measure ordering only after the literal matcher has already included the primary Memory.
scope_precondition.enforcement: For every task, candidate membership must equal the frozen set of primary, acceptable-entry-point, and distractor labels.
scope_precondition.implication: No result in this package estimates candidate-generation recall or compares literal, FTS, semantic, or hybrid matching.

prior_experiment_unbounded_observation.status: exploratory; discovered after the original confirmatory analysis

interpretation.supported: Showing every matched candidate does not guarantee correct use of the relevant Memory; reasoning or selection load remains after retrieval succeeds.
interpretation.not_supported: The observation does not isolate distractor density causally because corpus size, match-set size, and task identity co-vary.
interpretation.next_test: At a fixed 500-Memory corpus, vary matched-candidate counts near 10, 40, and 150 within each graph family while keeping the useful Memory, labels, model, projection, and ordering fixed.

decision_impact.reason: The ordering comparisons remain paired and causally isolated; this evidence adds a separate reasoning-load limitation.
decision_impact.change: Prioritize a fixed-corpus candidate-density experiment, while keeping candidate-generation recall as a separate lexical-miss experiment.

recovery_audit.reason: All 1008 initial follow-up agent cells completed before the proposed amendment's registered timestamp, so it cannot serve as a preregistration. Only independently reproduced scope and exploratory observations are retained.
